items.title: Rates & weights page
items.detail: One Admin page for the things that change with dates: the weight of each bottle size (a new version applies from the date you choose, old orders keep their old weights) and the payment proof rules.

items.title: Payment proof with two screenshots
items.detail: A prepaid or part-prepaid manual order needs the customer's paid screen and the receiver's screen. They must show the same amount and UTR, the money must go to TM Perfume House / Fourpirates Ventures LLP, and the UTR must be new. Otherwise the order is refused with the reason. The gateway (Razorpay, Quick, UPI QR, Bank transfer) is read from the receiver's screen.
